aeronautics.basis_words: AERO is the local code at 7 colleges
aeronautics._notes: Assigned at Likely (86%): the local code colleges already use. AERO is the local code at 7 colleges. No M-ID is minted under it yet. AERO also prefixes nine Air Force ROTC M-IDs with no discipline (AS100 Heritage and Values); they belong with Military Studies (MILS).
aeronautics.authority_note: Common SUBJ AERO is assigned by the CSR; no C-ID or CCN code names this discipline's courses yet.

aliases_before._about: Fan-in discipline aliases: canonical → [alternate names]. Surfaced as an 'also:' chip on the CSR. See docs/kin_pe_convergence_scope.md.
aliases_before._updated_by: Sam, 2026-09-08 (the hard-ones sheet, item 2): "Put these in ethnic studies." African American Studies and Asian American Studies are MQ disciplines carrying ZERO courses anywhere on the map, while their three siblings carry 534 (Ethnic Studies, ETHS), 35 (Chicano Studies, ETHN) and 33 (Native American/American Indian Studies, ETHA). The two with courses stay distinct; the two empty ones fold in. ⚠️ They are real MQ disciplines, not alternate spellings — this records where we FILE such a course, not that the names are synonyms.
